messages:
deploy-bot: Manual approval requested for PROD deploy

deploy-bot: Service: redwood-api
Commit: a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0
Tag: v2.14.0
Image pinned: rwd-model:2026-03-12-1
Change window: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC -> 23:00 UTC
Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (15m checks between steps)
Risk: medium — non-breaking schema changes + model upgrade
Release notes: https://redwood.in/releases/2.14.0
Approvals required: 2 (SRE/Eng lead)

deploy-bot: Preflight summary:
• no DB migrations
• infra autoscaler ok
• previous deploy tag v2.13.8 healthy for 7d

deploy-bot: To approve run:```/deploy approve 1769004321 --by=@your-name```

micah: I'll run quick smoke tests on staging now. ping me when canary starts.

alex_sre: Holding for a minute — saw 15% CPU spike on node-pool-3 45m ago. Need to confirm node drain won't overlap canary.

kate_pm: Heads up — marketing has a coordinated launch at 22:30 in APAC. If we go full 100% at 22:20 there may be overlap. Can we keep traffic cutoff controls and avoid any rollback during 22:15-22:45? :thinking_face:

sam-dev: Note: model-serving runtime pinned to rwd-model:2026-03-12-1 to avoid quantization drift. We tested locally with the new prompt templates. Rollback plan: revert to tag v2.13.8 + rollback-config `--model rwd-model:2026-03-05-2`.

priya: Quick question — any feature flags gating this? Need to confirm we can turn off the new reranker if we see regressions.

sam-dev: Yes — reranker behind ff: `reranker_v2_enabled` (default off). We will enable after canary checks pass.

ops-bot: Preflight checks completed:
• canary infra ready (3 nodes)
• health-check endpoint /_health responding 200
• circuit-breakers configured
• rollback hook verified: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=19`

micah: Smoke on staging: login flow + basic generation ✅  (samples look good). I'm +1 for approval once node-pool drain confirmed.

alex_sre: Node-pool-3 drain window adjusted, will not overlap. I'm +1. Metrics look stable for 30m. :thumbsup:

kate_pm: I'm approving so we don't miss the marketing window — but please avoid full promotion before 22:15. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Approval received (3/2). Approvals by: micah, alex_sre, kate_pm.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout to PROD (tag v2.14.0). Canary size: 5%.

deploy-bot: Canary check hooks: latency, error-rate, token-cost, custom-quality-eval. Running 15m monitoring.

micah: Observing canary: latency stable, no error spikes so far.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (5m):
• p95 latency +2%
• error-rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%)
• model-quality regression 0.0% on benchmark set

deploy-bot: Canary checks passed. Promoting to 25%.

priya: Monitoring UX flows for few minutes — looks good from my side.

sam-dev: Promotion to 100% scheduled with 15m buffer. Will keep reranker disabled until we run the eval suite.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% in progress.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete — tag v2.14.0 now live in PROD.

deploy-bot: Post-deploy notes:
• Backup snapshot taken at 2026-03-20T21:58:10Z
• No rollback triggered
• Duration: 18m
• Deployed by: automated pipeline after manual approvals

micah: Nice. I'll run the extended smoke set and queue a follow-up if anything odd shows up.

kate_pm: Thanks team — keeping an eye on user metrics for next 2h.

alex_sre: Marking this deploy as green from SRE side. :green_heart:

priya: Will open a quick post-deploy checklist doc with links to canary graphs.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot.
